description: Returns a link to the product page with the configuration filled in. A person must open it, enter their details and confirm; payment is always approved by a human.

addons.description: Add-on id -> quantity (toggles use 1). Ids come from get_price.

annual.description: Pay care yearly in advance (two months free).

care.description: Monthly care plan to add to a site or system. Default: premium.

currency.description: Currency of the prices. Default: USD.

product.description: Product id, e.g. "site" (business website) or "landing" (landing page).

name: start_checkout
title: Prepare an order for a person to confirm
